**Public beta security update — feedback is welcome.** Questions, bugs and suggestions: **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** or [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

Stardew Tracker is a local, offline progress tracker for Stardew Valley 1.5 / 1.6 saves. This update is recommended over beta.3. It keeps the same interface and save data format; no mod, SMAPI or Python installation is needed for the packaged apps.

## Download

| System | File | Inside |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `StardewTracker-windows-v0.4.0-beta.4.zip` | `StardewTracker.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon only) | `StardewTracker-macos-v0.4.0-beta.4.zip` | `StardewTracker` |
| Linux (x86-64) | `StardewTracker-linux-v0.4.0-beta.4.zip` | `StardewTracker` |

SHA-256 checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Unpack the archive and run the executable. The tracker opens a local browser page and asks before looking for standard save folders; you may choose another folder or decline. Nothing is uploaded. Your goals and notes remain in the same local app-data directory when you update.

The apps are **not code-signed**: Windows **SmartScreen** may require *More info → Run anyway*; macOS may require right-click → *Open*; Linux may require `chmod +x StardewTracker`. Only run software you trust and verify the checksum first.

## What changed since beta 3

- **Local API safety:** changing goals, permission to scan for saves, or the selected farm now rejects requests with a foreign web origin. POST requests also require a real JSON content type, preventing a web page from disguising a simple cross-site request as JSON. Normal same-origin use and CLI requests continue to work.
- **Imported goal safety:** a custom metric label in imported goals can no longer be interpreted as HTML. Unknown metric names are kept as text, without deleting saved goals or annotations.
- Regression tests cover both paths. This is a targeted security patch; the beta.3 UI improvements remain in place, including 40×40 px item controls, the actionable overview, updated phone sprites, and the revised landing page.

## Known limitations

- The redesign and full application audit are ongoing; collection and other pages have not all been rebuilt. Some controls outside item actions remain small.
- Multiplayer counts only the host. Older 1.5.6 saves lack some data. Remixed bundles and some completion details still need validation.
- The touch layout was checked in a browser with a synthetic farm, **not manually on a physical phone**. Windows/macOS/Linux binaries have automated CLI smoke tests, but this beta was not manually tested on all three systems. macOS targets Apple Silicon on recent macOS; Intel Macs are unsupported.

Unofficial fan project; not affiliated with ConcernedApe. Stardew Valley, its game data and sprites are © ConcernedApe.

## По-русски

**Публичная бета — сообщайте о проблемах:** **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** или [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

Это обновление безопасности рекомендуется вместо beta.3. Исправлена проверка источника изменяющих запросов к локальному серверу и типа JSON; нестандартные метрики импортированных целей больше не попадают в HTML как разметка. Цели, заметки и формат сохранённых данных не сбрасываются. Возможности beta.3 — крупные кнопки предметов, подсказка на главной и мобильная вёрстка — остаются.

Архивы для Windows, macOS (только Apple Silicon) и Linux указаны выше. Приложения не подписаны: SmartScreen или Gatekeeper могут показать предупреждение. Перед запуском можно проверить `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Приложение спрашивает разрешение перед поиском сохранений и ничего не загружает в интернет.

**Ограничения:** аудит и редизайн продолжаются, в мультиплеере учитывается только хост; тесты интерфейса на телефоне проводились в браузере на вымышленной ферме, а не на физическом устройстве. Автоматические smoke-тесты сборок есть для трёх ОС, но все сборки beta.4 вручную не проверены.
